summary: Our Sofea and the Secrets of the Forgotten Planets project is an interactive storybook where we follow the adventures of a little girl called Sofea exploring the Moon and Mars. In this journey, she uncovers the forgotten equipment of NASA like landing modules, scientific equipment, parachutes and other pieces of spacecrafts. Using colorful illustrations, interesting facts, interactive images and activities, children can learn about these artifacts and how they contribute to space exploration. Our project deals with the challenge, "Abandoned but Not Forgotten". It brings the discovery of NASA into a fun and educational story that can easily be understood by children. We stress the fact that even though these objects have been abandoned, their scientific and historical contributions remain significant. This project is essential in the sense that it sparks curiosity and creativity and inspires future generations towards STEM discipline
details:
Our project is an interactive storytelling book titled Sofea and the Secrets of the Forgotten Planets, which follows a young explorer named Sofea as she travels to the Moon and Mars to discover NASA's forgotten equipment. Through colourful illustrations, engaging stories, clickable objects, fun facts and interactive quizzes, children can learn about the purpose, functions and contributions of these objects to space exploration. Our project makes learning about space science more enjoyable and easier to understand while encouraging children's curiosity, creativity and interest in reading. It also aims to inspire the younger generation to explore STEM education and appreciate the historical and scientific value of NASA's abandoned equipment.
To develop this project, our team considers several important factors, including the target audience, scientific accuracy, visual appeal, simplicity and educational value. We use reliable NASA information to ensure that the facts presented are accurate and suitable for school-age children. Our creativity comes from combining storytelling, science and interactive learning instead of presenting information through ordinary textbooks. By introducing Sofea as the main character, we transform real space discoveries into an imaginative adventure that allows children to learn while having fun. Overall, our goal is to make space exploration more accessible, memorable and exciting for young readers.
